name: Stephen Augusta Gill
notable_stories: Prominent pioneer farmer and deacon in Union Township, Ohio
milestones: Born 17 Oct 1822, Newark, Licking County, Ohio
Religion: Faithful member of the Licking Baptist church, where he had been a deacon for the previous five years.
Buried with Harriet Josephine at Cedar Hill Cemetery
education: Attended the Newark public schools until age twelve.
career: Farmer specialising in sheep breeding and wool growing until 1906.
locations: Cedar Hill Cemetery, Newark, Licking County, Ohio
sources: Further Research on the Family and Descendants of Joseph P. and Elizabeth (Hamilton) Adams, William W. Allen (February 2012)
notes: Precise birth and death dates newly established.

Subject of a biographical sketch in the Centennial History of the City of Newark and Licking County, Ohio (E. M. P. Brister; the scanned title page reads 1908). [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 7506]
Voted Republican in national and state politics. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 7604]
A girl named Mary Swan was living with the Gills in the 1860 census. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 7820]
Mary R. Adams was listed as his niece in his household in the 1880 census. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 7901]
A Ralph S. Adams was living in the Gill household in the 1900 census. [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 8059]
Harriet Ray Adams was the informant on his death certificate [Bill Allen, Further Research, 2012, line 8580]
